# Defect report / RCA

- **Title:** Specific trigger and incorrect outcome
- **Classification:** Product / framework / expectation / data / environment
- **Domain:** Authentication / documents / persistence / contracts / framework / public-apis
- **Service and execution target:** Lab/provider; unit/local-http/SQLite/PostgreSQL/container/public
- **Failure phase / safe evidence ID / correlation ID:** Setup / call / teardown
- **Severity and priority:** State the concrete impact and urgency
- **Test node ID and command:**
- **Target and versions:** Local/live, Python, dependency pins, commit
- **Observed at:** Timestamp and timezone
- **Preconditions:** Safe configuration, discovered resource references
- **Steps to reproduce:** Minimal ordered steps
- **Expected:** Include the contract or framework invariant
- **Actual:** Include method/path/status and redacted evidence
- **Reproducibility:** Attempts and outcomes; avoid unnecessary public requests
- **Confirmed observations:**
- **Hypotheses:** Include alternatives and missing evidence
- **RCA status:** Confirmed / suspected / unknown
- **Root cause:** Explain the mechanism only when supported
- **Corrective action:** Smallest change addressing that mechanism
- **Regression coverage:** Test and assertion added or retained
- **Retest:** Commands, targets, outcomes, pending live evidence
- **Residual uncertainty:**

Keep tokens, passwords, cookies, and private body/query values out of this report.
